id_routing.description: Interconnect may append bits to AxID to identify the originating master; slave-side ID_WIDTH > master-side ID_WIDTH
id_routing.compliance_note: Returning ID is the WIDER value; routing strips appended bits before returning to the master

fields.topology_type: Star (Central + N Peripherals) + Broadcaster-Observer (connectionless) + Connected Isochronous Group (BLE 5.2 LE Audio Unicast) + Broadcast Isochronous Group (BLE 5.2 LE Audio Broadcast); multi-role devices may simultaneously be Central in one piconet + Peripheral in another (scatternet).

supported_topologies.name: Star — Central + Peripherals
supported_topologies.description: One Central holds 1..N connections to Peripherals; each Peripheral typically holds 1 connection.

supported_topologies.name: Broadcaster + Observer (connectionless)
supported_topologies.description: Broadcaster transmits ADV_NONCONN_IND on channels 37/38/39; Observer passively scans + reports.

supported_topologies.name: Multi-role (scatternet)
supported_topologies.description: Same device acts as Central in one piconet + Peripheral in another simultaneously; supported since BLE 4.1.

supported_topologies.name: Periodic Advertising train
supported_topologies.description: Broadcaster sends AUX_SYNC_IND on deterministic schedule on data channels; receivers acquire sync (BLE 5).

supported_topologies.name: Connected Isochronous Group (CIG)
supported_topologies.description: BLE 5.2 LE Audio Unicast — Central manages a CIG of CIS streams to one or more Peripherals.

supported_topologies.name: Broadcast Isochronous Group (BIG)
supported_topologies.description: BLE 5.2 LE Audio Broadcast — Broadcaster transmits BIS streams to unlimited Synchronized Receivers.

supported_topologies.name: Bluetooth Mesh (separate spec)
supported_topologies.description: Layered on BLE advertising bearer (ADV) + GATT bearer; supports many-to-many relay topology.

master_slave_role_summary.description: Connection master; initiates all connection events; assigns Access Address + CRCInit + ChM + Hop + Interval + Timeout; schedules data + control PDUs.
Connection slave; listens at scheduled anchors; responds to Central; may reject parameter updates with LL_REJECT_IND.
Connectionless transmitter — advertises but does not accept SCAN_REQ or CONNECT_IND.
Connectionless receiver — passively scans for advertising packets.
Transient role within Observer; passive or active (issues SCAN_REQ).
Transient role within Central; transmits CONNECT_IND on receipt of matching ADV_IND.
BLE 5.2 LE Audio Broadcast source; transmits BIS PDUs on a BIG schedule.
BLE 5.2 LE Audio Broadcast sink; acquires BIG via BASE + decodes BIS PDUs.

fields.interconnect_role: BLE link layer carries L2CAP traffic between Controller and Host. Above L2CAP: ATT / GATT for attribute access; SMP for pairing / bonding; GAP for role + discovery; LE Audio profiles (BAP / PACS / CSIP / VCP / MCP / TMAP) for unicast / broadcast audio.

ordering_guarantees.per_LL_connection_in_order: SN / NESN enforce in-order delivery of LL Data PDUs over a connection; CRC + Access Address + whitening enforce per-packet integrity.
ordering_guarantees.frame_boundary: All periodic events (Advertising, Connection, Periodic Advertising, Isochronous) follow deterministic interval schedules.
ordering_guarantees.host_scheduling: Above HCI, host stack schedules ATT requests + L2CAP fragments; EATT (BLE 5.2) adds per-bearer credits + flow control.

fields.memory_vs_peripheral_regions: Not applicable — UART is one peripheral; its 8 register slots live in the SoC's I/O space.

slave_classification.polling_target: Software polls LSR.DR / THRE for non-interrupt-driven operation.
slave_classification.interrupt_target: INTR signal drives external interrupt controller; software services via IIR-identified source.
slave_classification.dma_target: TXRDY/RXRDY drive an external DMA controller for high-throughput data movement.

default_signal_values_evidence_tables: Table I — Reset Configuration of the UART

modem_control_topology.active_polarity: All modem control signals are active LOW at the modem interface.

device_classification.function: Capability-providing device (HID, MSC, Audio, Video, CDC, Printer, etc.).
device_classification.hub: Bus-forwarding device adding more downstream ports.
device_classification.compound_device: Hub + function(s) in one physical package.
device_classification.self_powered_device: Power from local source; ≤ 100 mA from VBUS for enumeration only.
device_classification.bus_powered_device: All power from VBUS; ≤ 100 mA pre-config / ≤ 500 mA configured.
device_classification.broadcaster: Connectionless transmitter — beacons, sensors, iBeacon, Eddystone.
device_classification.observer: Connectionless receiver — beacon scanners, indoor positioning anchors.
device_classification.peripheral: Connection slave — heart rate sensor, blood pressure monitor, keyboard, mouse.
device_classification.central: Connection master — smartphone, gateway, smart-home hub.
device_classification.multi_role: Both Central + Peripheral simultaneously — smartwatch, fitness band, audio dongle.
device_classification.isochronous_broadcaster: BLE 5.2 broadcast audio source — public-venue audio, TV with hearing-aid broadcast.
device_classification.synchronized_receiver: BLE 5.2 broadcast audio sink — LE Audio hearing aids, broadcast-audio earbuds.
